data.subject: Quotation: FCL 1 x 40HC Rotterdam to New York (household furniture)
data.body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for your quote request. We are pleased to offer the following for your shipment:

Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
Commodity: household furniture
Container: 1 x 40HC

All-in total: EUR 3520

This all-in rate includes the following charges:
- Base freight: EUR 2550 per container
- BAF: EUR 320 per container
- THC Rotterdam: EUR 225 per container
- THC New York: EUR 290 per container
- ISPS: EUR 25 per container
- Documentation: EUR 65 per shipment
- Export customs: EUR 45 per shipment

This quotation is valid through 2026-12-31.

If you would like to proceed, please reply to this email to confirm, along with your expected cargo-ready date. We will then arrange the booking. We are also happy to answer any questions you may have.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
